verdict.rationale: Numeral clearly offers an API-driven tax calculation endpoint that takes an address (or IP) and products and returns accurate tax (docs-1, docs-17, docs-19, docs-27), which supports address-level accuracy rather than ZIP-only approximation. However, there is no explicit evidence of latency/performance benchmarks, checkout-speed SLAs, or independent verification of rooftop-level address precision (e.g., no mention of geocoding granularity, response time guarantees, or third-party accuracy audits). missing for 10: documented latency/performance guarantees for checkout use, explicit rooftop-level (vs street-level) accuracy claims, independent benchmarking or customer validation of real-time speed.
